transport: in-session live run via a real Claude Code sub-agent driving scripts/agent_env.py; scripts/run_agent.py runs the SAME environment through the Anthropic API for n>=5

steps.reasoning: Start minimal with just glucose uptake to establish a baseline and see which tests are already satisfied versus which require lactose metabolism.

Baseline showed lactose never consumed and growth insufficient (only glucose contributed biomass). lactose_uptake lets the cell consume lactose; but its rate is gated by lac_repression, which only catabolite_repression writes (from glucose via a Hill switch) to enforce the diauxic sequential shift. Install all three.

runs.final_note: Required combining Monod uptake for glucose and lactose with a catabolite-repression Hill switch gating lactose uptake via lac_repression, so glucose is consumed first.

summary.note: n=1 in-session; run scripts/run_agent.py --task diauxie --runs 5 with an API key for the full n>=5 distribution.
